value.basis: Lab 4-choice RT with spatially compatible keys in young adults runs ~420-470 ms (e.g., Deary-Liewald task), with medians slightly below means; browser/keyboard/display latency adds roughly 40-70 ms and only 5 practice trials leaves little warm-up, so medians around 480-490 ms are expected. Between-person SD in young adults is typically 50-65 ms, inflated somewhat by heterogeneous hardware and unproctored attention in online testing.
